title: INCHEON INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT CORPORATION ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Act is to ensure the efficient construction, management, and operation of Incheon International Airport and to foster it into a global airport specialized enterprise, thereby contributing to smooth air transportation and the development of the national economy.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 2 (Corporate personality) The Incheon International Airport Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the "Corporation") shall be a corporation.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 3 (Offices) (1) The seat of the Corporation's principal office shall be prescribed by its articles of incorporation.
  (2) The Corporation may, if deemed necessary to perform its business, open its branches or offices, following the resolution of the board of directors.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 4 (Stocks) (1) The Corporation's capital shall consist of its stock.
  (2) The State or a local government may invest movable or immovable property necessary for the business of the Corporation in the Corporation in kind.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 5 (Registration) (1) The Corporation shall be established at the time when it registers such establishment at the location of its main office.
  (2) Necessary matters concerning the registration of establishment of the Corporation under paragraph (1), the registration of installation, transfer, or alteration of its branch or offices, and other registration of the Corporation shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  (3) With respect to matters requiring registration, the Corporation may not oppose any third party without making registration thereof.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 6 (Prohibition of use of similar names) Anyone who is not the Corporation provided for in this Act shall be prohibited from using the Incheon International Airport Corporation or any other similar names.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 7 Deleted. <Mar. 25, 2009>

Article 8 (Appointment of agents) The President may appoint an agent having authority to perform all judicial or extrajudicial acts in connection with the affairs of the Corporation, from among its employees, as prescribed by its articles of incorporation.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 9 (Prohibition of divulging confidential information) No person who is or was an executive officer or employee of the Corporation shall divulge or misuse confidential information that comes to his or her knowledge in the course of performing duties.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 10 (Projects) (1) The Corporation shall implement the following projects in order to achieve the purpose referred to in Article 1: <Amended on Mar. 29, 2016; Feb. 13, 2024>
  1. Development of Incheon International Airport among airport development projects under subparagraph 9 of Article 2 of the Airport Facilities Act;
  2. Management, operation, maintenance, and repair of Incheon International Airport and development projects for the adjacent areas necessary therefor;
  3. Management and operation of roads connected with Incheon International Airport;
  4. Research and investigation on the construction, management and operation of Incheon International Airport;
  5. Projects incidental to those listed in subparagraphs 1 through 4, as prescribed by Presidential Decree;
  6. Telecommunications business related to airport services;
  7. Consulting services related to construction, operation, etc. of airports;
  8. Construction, management, and operation of overseas airports and development projects of their neighboring areas;
  9. Other projects entrusted by the State or local governments in connection with the construction, management, and operation of Incheon International Airport.
  (2) The Corporation may invest in projects necessary for efficiently promoting the projects referred to in paragraph (1) within its budgetary limits, following a resolution of the board of directors.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 11 (Free lease of the State property) (1) Where the Government deems it necessary for the Corporation to efficiently implement the projects under the subparagraphs of Article 10 (1), the Government may lease the State property to the Corporation without compensation therefor, or allow the Corporation to use or to make profits from such property, notwithstanding the provisions of the State Property Act.
  (2) Notwithstanding the State Property Act, the Corporation may construct buildings or other permanent facilities on the State property for which it has received a loan or permission for using and profiting pursuant to paragraph (1).
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 12 (Sublease of the State property) (1) If deemed necessary for the efficient implementation of the projects under the subparagraphs of Article 10 (1), the Corporation may sublease the State property leased, or allowed to use or to make a profit under Article 11.
  (2) When the Corporation intends to sublease any State property pursuant to paragraph (1), it shall obtain approval therefor from the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. The same shall also apply to any modification thereof. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
  (3) No person to whom State property is subleased under paragraph (1) shall lease or allow any other person to use, or make a profit from, such property.
  (4) Any person who has obtained a sublease of State property pursuant to paragraph (1) shall construct a building or other permanent facilities on the property; provided, he or she may construct a building or other permanent facilities on the property, if the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport deems it necessary for administrative purposes or for the performance of duties of the Corporation to be reverted to the State. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 13 (Subsidies) The Government may partially subsidize expenses incurred in the projects of the Corporation, finance treasury fund to the Corporation, or assume bonds issued by the Corporation within its budgetary limits.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 14 (Issuance of bonds) (1) The Corporation may issue bonds, following a resolution of the board of directors.
  (2) The amount of bonds to be issued shall not exceed 4 times the aggregate capital and reserve of the Corporation.
  (3) The Government may guarantee the repayment of the principal and interest of bonds issued by the Corporation.
  (4) The period of extinctive prescription of bonds shall be 5 years for the principal and 2 years for interest.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 15 (Borrowing of funds) The Corporation may borrow necessary funds and goods (including borrowing funds and import of goods from overseas countries), following a resolution of the board of directors.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 16 (Guidance and supervision) The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may guide and supervise the Corporation with respect to the following matters and affairs related thereto, to enhance public nature and public interests of the operation of Incheon International Airport: <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
  1. Matters concerning the security of airport facilities and aviation safety;
  2. Matters concerning convenience and safety of the users of airport facilities.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 17 (Report to National Assembly) The Corporation shall report matters concerning the construction, management, and operation of Incheon International Airport and major project plans to the National Assembly at least once a year. <Amended on Feb. 13, 2024>
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 18 (Relationship to other statutes) Except as provided in this Act or the Act on the Management of Public Institutions, the provisions governing the stock company of the Commercial Act and the Act on the Improvement of Managerial Structure and Privatization of Public Enterprises shall apply to the Corporation; provided, Article 292 of the Commercial Act shall not apply to the Corporation.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 19 (Penalty provisions) A person who has violated Article 9 shall be punished by imprisonment with labor for up to 2 years or by a fine not exceeding 20 million won: <Amended on Nov. 28, 2017>
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

Article 20 (Administrative fines) (1) Any person who violates Article 6 shall be punished by an administrative fine not exceeding 5 million won.
  (2) Administrative fines under paragraph (1) shall be imposed and collected by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 25, 2009]

ADDENDA <Act No. 5689, Jan. 26, 1999>
Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Act shall enter into force on February 1, 1999; provided, the amended provisions of Articles 3 and 4 of the Addenda shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Repeal of other statutes)
The Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation Act shall be repealed.
Article 3 (Incorporation preparation of corporation)
(1) The Corporation Incorporation Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "Incorporation Committee") shall be set up with the mandate of dealing with administrative affairs involving the incorporation of the Corporation.
(2) The Incorporation Committee shall consist of not more than 7 members commissioned by the Minister of Construction and Transportation, and the chairman of the Incorporation Committee shall be the Vice Minister of Construction and Transportation.
(3) The members of the Incorporation Committee under paragraph (2) shall be deemed promoters provided for in Article 288 of the Commercial Act.
(4) The Incorporation Committee shall prepare the articles of incorporation of the Corporation and its members shall subscribe or sign their names thereon.
(5) The Incorporation Committee shall complete the registration of incorporation of the Corporation by the date this Act enters into force.
Article 4 (Incorporation expenses)
Expenses required for incorporating the Corporation shall be borne by the Corporation.
Article 5 (Succession to property, rights, and obligations)
(1) The property, rights, and obligations of the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation as at the time this Act enters into force shall be comprehensively succeeded to the property, the rights, and obligations of the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation simultaneously with the establishment of the Corporation.
(2) The name of the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation that is put on the register book and other public register with regard to its properties, rights and duties that are succeeded in the block by the Corporation under paragraph (1) shall be deemed the name of the Corporation.
(3) The value of the properties that are succeeded by the Corporation under paragraph (1) shall be the book value thereof at the time of succession.
(4) Any act performed by the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation in connection with the projects of Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction, or any other act performed against the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation prior to the incorporation of the Corporation shall be deemed an act performed by the Corporation or an act performed against the Corporation.
Article 6 (Transitional measures concerning executive officers and employees of the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation)
(1) The chairperson, directors (including the vice chief director; hereafter the same shall apply in this paragraph) and auditors of the Seoul Metropolitan Airport New Airport Construction Corporation as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed the president, directors, and auditors under this Act, respectively, and their terms of office shall be the terms of office until a new president, directors, and auditors are appointed at a general meeting of shareholders.
(2) The employees of the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed the employees of the Corporation.
Article 7 (Special cases concerning appointment of employees of the Korea Airports Authority)
The Corporation may appoint employees of the Korea Airports Authority in charge of the management and operation of Incheon International Airport as at the time this Act enters into force as employees of the Corporation.
Article 8 (Investment in land and facilities)
(1) The land and facilities (excluding those equivalent in value to contributions or subsidies deemed as investments in the corporation in accordance with paragraphs (2) or (3)) to be installed by the Corporation in the course of implementing the Incheon International Airport construction project shall be deemed to have been invested in kind by the State in the Corporation simultaneously with the completion of the relevant project; provided, the same shall not apply to the land and facilities to be managed by the State or local governments, and the land and facilities equivalent to the borrowings procured by the Corporation shall revert to the Corporation upon completion, notwithstanding the provisions of Article 21 (2) of the Airport Facilities Act. <Amended on Mar. 29, 2016>
(2) Contributions or subsidies, etc. contributed or paid by the Government to the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation under the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Promotion Act and the previous Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation Act before this Act enters into force(including investment amounts other than the funds procured through borrowings by the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation) shall be deemed to have been invested by the State in the Corporation on the date this Act enters into force.
(3) Where the Government decided to contribute or pay contributions or subsidies to the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Authority before this Act enters into force, it shall be deemed to have decided to invest in the Corporation.
(4) The value of investment in land and facilities deemed to be invested in kind by the State in the construction pursuant to the main clause of paragraph (1) shall be calculated in accordance with the Act on the Investment in Kind of the State property at the time of completion, and in this case, the Minister of Finance and Economy shall be deemed the Minister of Construction and Transportation.
Article 9 (Transitional measures concerning penalty provisions)
The application of the penalty provisions to any violation of the previous provisions of the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation Act prior to the enforcement of this Act shall be governed by the previous provisions of the Seoul Metropolitan Area New Airport Construction Corporation Act.
Article 10 Omitted.
